findings.title: Possible NPE when the 'Clients' resource-type resource is missing
findings.body: In hasPermission(ClientModel, String), when no per-client resource exists the code falls back to AdminPermissionsSchema.SCHEMA.getResourceTypeResource(...), which can return null (it returns null when the realm doesn't support the authz schema, when the type is unknown, or when the named resource simply isn't found). The returned value is passed directly to policyStore.findByResource(server, resource) and then dereferenced via resource.getScopes(), so a null fallback causes a NullPointerException (HTTP 500) instead of a clean 'deny'. Add a null check returning false.

findings.title: getClientsWithPermission can return the resource-type resource name
findings.body: resourceStore.findByType(server, CLIENTS_RESOURCE_TYPE, ...) also matches the generic 'Clients' resource created by the schema for all-clients permissions (its type equals the resource type). Its name ('Clients') is not a client id, so the returned set may contain a bogus entry that callers use to filter/lookup clients, leading to incorrect client listings. Skip the resource whose name equals CLIENTS_RESOURCE_TYPE (or expand it to all clients).

findings.title: getResourceName not implemented for the new Clients resource type
findings.body: getResourceName() only handles the USERS resource type; for policies with resourceType 'Clients' it falls through to resource.getDisplayName(), which is not set for resources created by getOrCreateResource(). As a result the admin API/console will show null/empty names for client-scoped permissions instead of the clientId (and 'All clients' for the type resource). Add a CLIENTS branch resolving the client by id.

findings.title: Cleanup listener now skipped when only V2 is enabled
findings.body: The removal listener (role/client/group removal -> setPermissionsEnabled(false)) is now guarded by Profile.Feature.ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ. If a deployment previously created V1 permission resources and then runs with ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ disabled (e.g. only V2 enabled), orphan authorization resources/policies for removed roles, clients and groups will no longer be cleaned up, leaving stale data. Consider still cleaning up V1 data regardless of the flag, or document the migration.

findings.title: Dead code and unused imports in new class
findings.body: getEvaluationContext(...) is private and never used, and the imports for TOKEN_EXCHANGE, Scope, ClientModelIdentity, DefaultEvaluationContext, EvaluationContext and the unused `logger` field are dead. Removing them avoids confusion about token-exchange evaluation being supported in V2 (canExchangeTo throws UnsupportedOperationException).
